subject: Proposal: confidential manager transfer for Samira Khan
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Proposal: confidential manager transfer for Samira Khan

Hi Lauren / Monica —

I need to propose a sensitive manager reassignment for Samira Khan (Eng, Team Delta). After the most recent performance checkpoint the manager pair agreed a 60-day PIP; there are also accommodation requests pending (reduced on-site days) that make the reporting relationship suboptimal. To minimize disruption and protect confidentiality, I recommend we transfer Samira to Ben Carter as interim manager effective Jan 19.

Key points:
- Reason: ongoing PIP plus an accommodation that requires a manager with flexible on-call coverage.
- Candidate: Ben Carter (has prior coaching experience and bandwidth for a short-term reassignment).
- Timeline: propose handoff week of Jan 19 — formal transfer for 60 days, review on Mar 19.
- Confidentiality: limit recipients during initial coordination; HR/legal loop required before any formal communication to the employee.

I've attached a short PIP summary and a draft handoff checklist to help planning. Monica, can you confirm any HR constraints or required notices? Lauren, can you confirm Ben's availability/consent?

Thanks —
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Director, Product Ops
Redwood Inference
(attachment: samira_pip_summary.pdf, manager_handoff_checklist.xlsx)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-09T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: confidential manager transfer for Samira Khan

Dylan —

Thanks for the heads-up and for keeping this tight. I spoke to Ben briefly this morning and he indicated he's open to covering Samira on an interim basis, provided we set clear expectations up front. He asked for:

- A one-hour sync with me and the current manager to go over the PIP goals and performance history.
- Access to the last three 1:1 notes and the current OKR milestones.
- Clarity on escalation/decision authority for growth vs. separation decisions.

Ben, can you confirm your availability for a handoff on Jan 19 and whether you'd be comfortable taking primary manager responsibilities (1:1 cadence, performance checkpoints) for the 60-day window?

Monica — please confirm any notice requirements and whether Legal needs to review the PIP language prior to the handoff.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
VP, Engineering — Core Platforms

Lauren / Dylan —

I can take Samira on as interim manager. Jan 19 handoff works for me; availability windows that week are: Jan 19 (afternoon), Jan 20 (morning), Jan 21 (all day).

I agree on the one-hour walkthrough and would like a bullet summary of the last three 1:1s (high level). I also want to be explicit: I will not make termination decisions without a cross-functional review with HR and Legal.

Happy to proceed — Ben

Subject: Re: Proposal: confidential manager transfer for Samira Khan

Dylan / Lauren / Ben —

Thanks for pulling this together. HR has reviewed the PIP summary and the accommodation note. A few required items before we can execute:

1) A short written acknowledgment from Ben accepting interim manager duties and the scope (please include that termination decisions will require HR/Legal sign-off).
2) A private meeting with Samira to present the change in manager — HR will attend that meeting.
3) Documentation: consolidate the last 3 1:1s and the PIP goals into a single handoff doc (we'll use the attached checklist).
4) Legal wants to scan the PIP language; please send the redlined copy so they can confirm compliance.

I've looped in Elena Morris from our external HR partner for any uplift on accommodation administration; Legal is on CC for early review. We will need to keep this limited to the people on this thread until after HR meets with Samira.

Monica Patel
Sr. People Partner
Redwood Inference

Monica / team —

We can support the accommodation transition and will be available to attend the Samira handoff meeting the week of Jan 19. A couple of notes from HR/Legal review:

- Legal has reviewed the PIP summary and requests one minor wording change on the "next steps" section to avoid implying a predetermined outcome; Monica, I'll DM the exact suggested phrasing.
- Before the private meeting with Samira, HR will prepare a short document outlining the accommodation adjustments and expected check-ins.
- We recommend scheduling the private manager handoff on Jan 19 at 2pm PST (Ben, please confirm). HR/Elena and Monica will join; Legal will be on standby.

If everyone confirms, we'll prepare the meeting invite and the joint handoff doc.
